changelog: - **Lines that leave a node at the same stage start together in playback, and a chip is placed again when only what it shows changes.** In a step's playback, lines at the same stage of the flow used to start one after another in the order of their ids, and a stage could be split between two start times. Now every line at one stage starts together, in at most six start times per step. On the Coffee roastery Template, the three lines leaving Roasted bean stock start together and a step has three start times instead of six. On the Coffee roasting batch Template, the drum's three outputs leave together: for about the first fifth of a step their tokens are bunched and one amount badge shows a moment later, then each reads as before. The route map also placed a chip again only when its size changed: a chip that started showing its unit at the same size, or two repeated Value changes after one was made a Trigger in the Inspector, kept the previous placement until something else changed. Both now place the chips again.
